Info

Defines structural protocol IElbowReconfigurationPlanner for arm configuration transitions.

class scaralang.core.service.trajectory.reconfiguration.ireconfiguration_planner.IElbowReconfigurationPlanner(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining arm elbow configuration transition planning.

It defines:

methods:
is_reconfiguration_required - Checks if elbow reconfiguration is needed.
plan_reconfiguration - Generates safe intermediate transition waypoints.
get_version - Returns planner component version string.
_abc_impl = <_abc._abc_data object>¶
_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
get_version() → str[source]¶

Returns planner component version string representation.

Returns:

Semantic version string.

is_reconfiguration_required(from_elbow: ElbowConfig, to_elbow: ElbowConfig) → bool[source]¶

Determines whether a transition between two elbow configurations is required.

Parameters:

  • from_elbow – Current arm kinematic elbow configuration.

  • to_elbow – Target arm kinematic elbow configuration.

Returns:

True if configurations differ and reconfiguration is needed, False otherwise.

plan_reconfiguration(request: ReconfigurationRequest) → list[Waypoint][source]¶

Plans intermediate waypoints to safely reconfigure robot elbow from one pose to another.

Parameters:

request – ReconfigurationRequest parameter bundle containing transition parameters.

Returns:

Ordered list of intermediate transition waypoints leading to target pose.
